verdict.rationale: Chargebee ships a documented REST API for creating/managing subscriptions and applying credits/plan changes, plus official and custom MCP servers explicitly designed to let AI clients (Cursor, Claude, ChatGPT, etc.) access a scoped subset of billing tools (e.g., an invoice-lookup server exposing only certain tools). This directly matches the agent+scoped-permissions story. Missing for 10: concrete documentation of fine-grained per-action scopes (e.g., credit-only vs plan-change-only API keys) and independent/hands-on validation of MCP scoping in practice.
